translations.web: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
translations.bsb: and say: ‘What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions; she reared her cubs.
translations.kjv: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
